enum Activation
  ON_DEMAND = 'on_demand'
  ATTACH = 'attach'
  REMOTE = 'remote'
enum ApplicationActivationOutcome
  READY = 'ready'
  UNKNOWN = 'unknown'
  DISABLED = 'disabled'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
  LAUNCH_REFUSED = 'launch_refused'
  IDENTITY_REFUSED = 'identity_refused'
  NOT_READY = 'not_ready'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
dataclass ApplicationActivationRecipe
  arguments: list[str]
  readiness: ApplicationInterface
  readiness_timeout_ms: int
dataclass ApplicationActivationResult
  outcome: ApplicationActivationOutcome | None
  instance: str
  started: bool
  reason: str
dataclass ApplicationChange
  outcome: ApplicationOutcome | None
  instance: str
  reason: str
dataclass ApplicationContext
  name: str
  title: str
  revision: str
dataclass ApplicationDescriptor
  name: str
  program: str
  title: str
  start_guidance: str
  activation: ApplicationActivationRecipe | None
dataclass ApplicationEntry
  descriptor: ApplicationDescriptor
  instances: list[ApplicationInstance]
  scope: Scope | None
dataclass ApplicationInstance
  instance: str
  interfaces: list[ApplicationInterface]
  contexts: list[ApplicationContext]
  expires_unix_ms: int
dataclass ApplicationInterface
  name: str
  protocol: str
  contract: str
enum ApplicationOutcome
  APPLIED = 'applied'
  PAGE = 'page'
  UNKNOWN = 'unknown'
  STALE = 'stale'
  CONFLICT = 'conflict'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
dataclass ApplicationPage
  outcome: ApplicationOutcome | None
  cursor: str
  applications: list[ApplicationEntry]
dataclass ApplicationPresence
  application: str
  instance: str
  interfaces: list[ApplicationInterface]
  contexts: list[ApplicationContext]
  lease_ms: int
class Applications
  register(descriptor: ApplicationDescriptor) -> ApplicationChange
  remove(application: str) -> ApplicationChange
  announce(presence: ApplicationPresence) -> ApplicationChange
  withdraw(application: str, instance: str) -> ApplicationChange
  observe(cursor: str, wait_ms: int) -> ApplicationPage
  activate(application: str) -> ApplicationActivationResult
class ApplicationsClient(Applications)
  __init__(transport)
  register(descriptor: ApplicationDescriptor) -> ApplicationChange
  remove(application: str) -> ApplicationChange
  announce(presence: ApplicationPresence) -> ApplicationChange
  withdraw(application: str, instance: str) -> ApplicationChange
  observe(cursor: str, wait_ms: int) -> ApplicationPage
  activate(application: str) -> ApplicationActivationResult
dataclass BootstrapObservation
  state: BootstrapState | None
  detail: str
enum BootstrapState
  UNKNOWN = 'unknown'
  INSTALLED = 'installed'
  STARTING = 'starting'
  RUNNING = 'running'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
class Caller
  observe() -> CallerObservation
dataclass CallerAttribute
  attribute: str
  proof: str
  ceiling: str
class CallerClient(Caller)
  __init__(transport)
  observe() -> CallerObservation
dataclass CallerObservation

  program: str
  pid: int
  attributes: list[CallerAttribute]
  platform: str
  transport: str
  bindable: bool
  stronger: str

  OBSERVED = 'observed'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
dataclass CapabilityObservation

const DECLARATION_RESOURCE_KINDS
const DEFAULT_RUNTIME_CONTRACTS

  models: list[str]

enum DeclarationEditOutcome
  APPLIED = 'applied'
  CONFLICT = 'conflict'
  UNKNOWN = 'unknown'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'

enum DeclarationReadiness
  READY = 'ready'
  IDLE = 'idle'
  STARTING = 'starting'
  RESTARTING = 'restarting'
  REFUSED = 'refused'
  UNREACHABLE = 'unreachable'
  NOT_READY = 'not_ready'

  __init__(code)

const REGISTRY_ACTIONS
class Refusal(ValueError)
  __init__(word, offset)
class Registry
  declarations() -> DeclarationList
  declare(expected_revision: str, declaration: Declaration) -> DeclarationChange
  withdraw(expected_revision: str, name: str) -> DeclarationChange
  observe(cursor: str, wait_ms: int) -> DeclarationObservation
class RegistryClient(Registry)
  __init__(transport)
  declarations() -> DeclarationList
  declare(expected_revision: str, declaration: Declaration) -> DeclarationChange
  withdraw(expected_revision: str, name: str) -> DeclarationChange
  observe(cursor: str, wait_ms: int) -> DeclarationObservation
dataclass RemoteTrust
  server_name: str
  roots: str
  certificate: str
  key: str
  credential: str
enum ResolutionStatus
  RESOLVED = 'resolved'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
  INCOMPATIBLE = 'incompatible'
  UNMET_REQUIREMENTS = 'unmet_requirements'
  NOT_READY = 'not_ready'
  INVALID_REQUEST = 'invalid_request'
dataclass ResolveRequest
  capability: str
  contracts: list[str]
  guarantees: list[str]
  scope: Scope | None
dataclass ResolveResult
  status: ResolutionStatus | None
  reference: ServiceReference | None

enum Scope
  ANY = 'any'
  LOCAL = 'local'
  REMOTE = 'remote'
class ServiceError(Exception)
  __init__(code, message)
enum ServiceErrorCode
  HANDLER_ERROR = 'handler_error'
  INVALID_RESULT = 'invalid_result'
  UNKNOWN_VERSION = 'unknown_version'
  UNKNOWN_SERVICE = 'unknown_service'
  UNKNOWN_METHOD = 'unknown_method'
  WRONG_MODE = 'wrong_mode'

  READY = 'ready'
  NOT_READY = 'not_ready'
  UNKNOWN = 'unknown'

  provider: str

  transport: str
  endpoint: str
dataclass ServiceState
  contract: str
  readiness: ServiceReadiness | None
  why: str
  guarantees: list[str]
  capabilities: dict[str, str]
def decode(data)
def encode(v)
def service_name(frame)
